{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-6j11","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-nkbl: const violation writing dtn_buf through const pointer","description":"In `lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c`, line 82 adds `s_provider->dtn_buf = &s_dtn_buf;` but `s_provider` is declared as `static const struct lichen_deaddrop_provider *s_provider` at line 23. Writing to a member through a const-qualified pointer is a constraint violation in C (C11 §6.5.16/2). GCC -Wall -Werror reports: `error: assignment of member 'dtn_buf' in read-only object`.

Fix options:
1. Remove `const` from `s_provider` (replace `static const struct lichen_deaddrop_provider *` with `static struct lichen_deaddrop_provider *`)
2. Remove `const` from the function parameter in `lichen_coap_deaddrop_register` as well since it also stores into `s_provider`

The minimal fix is option 1: drop `const` on `s_provider` only, leaving the function parameter `const` since the caller's view should remain immutable -- only the internal static copy needs to be mutable.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T19:45:34.948404315Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T19:45:34.948404315Z"}
